boundaries: Both /api and /api/v1 aliases are preserved as separate actual mounted operations.
Dynamic {action} paths are one route, not invented per-action endpoints.
Flags/permission literals observed from source are evidence, not proof of effective authorization.
Manual Request validators are included as source validation models; absent response schemas remain unspecified rather than invented.
Middleware and original service authority remain required; route presence does not grant permission or configure a provider.
No request, model, server lifespan, database operation, browser or security audit ran during extraction.
Exact final SHA/tree and test results are supplied by separate final CI receipts.
